description: Append attributed agent commentary as an agent.annotation event. This never edits meeting markdown/frontmatter and is rejected unless the agent_id is allowed in ~/.minutes/agents.allow. Docs: https://useminutes.app/docs/mcp/tools#tool-add_agent_annotation

meeting_path.description: Target meeting markdown path, if known

span_end_ms.description: End offset of the target span in milliseconds

span_start_ms.description: Start offset of the target span in milliseconds

subkind.description: Annotation subtype, e.g. coaching, correction, risk, summary

tools.description: Tool or model names used to produce the annotation

name: add_agent_annotation
